answer: The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The vertex assignment is published and zephyr records each panel. Shards are assigned from the basalt graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4539 identities would post 1035 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
